taxonomy:
Here is a simple single-depth taxonomy of grid-based logic games, with each game placed into exactly one of 7 categories:

## 1. Number Placement
- Fillomino
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Kurotto
- Nansuke
- Nuritwin

## 2. Region Division
- Shikaku
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Nurikabe
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Five Cells
- Evolomino

## 3. Loop and Path
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Yajilin
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Nagareru
- Hebi
- Satogaeri

## 4. Shading and Coloring
- Akari
- LITS
- Norinori
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Tilepaint
- Usowan
- Moon-or-Sun
- Suraromu

## 5. Shape and Polyomino
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane
- Pencils
- Sto-stone
- Chained Block
- Juosan

## 6. Connectivity and Partition
- Makaro
- Yosenabe
- Nure?
